dataList.content: O the garden's sorrow-bearer, lamenter at the flower-funeral 阶前愁杀葬花人
Flower-rake in hand, teardrops in eyes, 独倚花锄泪暗洒
You carve bloodstained tears upon branches floral. 洒上空枝见血痕
I heard yesternight from the garden a song of grief, 昨宵庭外悲歌发
An elegy for a flower and a bird departing. 知是花魂与鸟魂
Availed naught to hold the parting spring, 惜春春去难挽留
Surrendered I become, heeding the endless woe sans relief. 几多泣声只相闻

<color=#9a2d30>Do you understand now, child? There is nothing you can do.</color>
<color=#9a2d30>现在明白了吗，你什么都做不到。</color>

<color=#9a2d30>Thus...</color>
<color=#9a2d30>所以……</color>

In the silent, windless sands...
在无风拂过的沙地上……
dataList.place:
Somewhere in Hongyuan
鸿园 某处

dataList.content:
... stood only the desolate ruins of a building, swept through and thoroughly destroyed by a brutal, unstoppable force that was determined to leave nothing in its wake.
像是被试图将一切事物摧毁殆尽的明确恶意肆虐过一般，仅剩一座惨不忍睹的建筑得以留存。
Remember the day ruin came to the Kong family, 勿忘孔家灭门之日。
who have brought this destruction upon themselves through their grave transgressions. 灭门皆因孔家罪孽深重。
To violate the laws of Hongyuan is no tragedy—as such, it warrants no pity, only humiliation and scorn. 对其未能遵守鸿园戒律之罪业，无需悲悯，只应感到可笑。
This site of history stands as a monument to the inevitability of karma. 因此，报应必当降至其身。

So this…
那么，这里就是……

... is the annihilated Kong family's... building?
那个已经灭门的孔家的……建筑吗？

Ishmael asked Hong Lu, having read the plaque on the building.
以实玛利读了读建筑前的看板上写的警告，回头向鸿璐问道。

Yes, it is.
是的，没错。
dataList.place:
Ruins of the Kong Family Building
孔家建筑的废墟

dataList.content:
And it's no longer in use.
现在这里已经被废弃了。

So everyone inside this building must’ve been…
那么，曾在这里面的所有人都……

What... kind of 'transgressions' could they possibly have committed to deserve to be destroyed like this...?
到底犯下了多重的罪……才会做到这种地步？

If there was something to lay waste to a building of such magnitude, with such totality, it... cannot have been a mere strife between Syndicates or Fixers. Something must've happened here, nothing less of a war, to leave these ruins behind.
这等规模的建筑彻底沦为了废墟……意味着这并非帮派或收尾人间的冲突造成的。应该是发生了……近乎战争规模的事件。

You’re right. It was unusual, even for the City.
是的。即使是在都市里也很难见到这幅光景吧。

And that’s because the Head was here.
毕竟首脑来到了这里。

Hong Lu replies, like it was the most obvious answer to a complicated question.
像是简单地解答出了复杂的谜题一样，鸿璐的回答十分自然。

The... Head.
首脑……吗。

So the Kong family… broke a Taboo...
所以是犯下了禁忌吗。孔家的人们……

... And the Sweepers came to clean up anything that was left behind, to erase any sign of whatever it was that violated the Taboo.
……那之后清道夫们进行了事后处理。为了让与禁忌有关的一切都荡然无存。

The Head… must really be a terrifying entity, if the mere mention of it could cause the Sinners to shrink so much. As we were ambling aimlessly with this revelation…
首脑……这个团体一定相当恐怖。正当罪人们大多面露难色，各自开始唉声叹气时。

Welcome, welcome to round 2 of the Evaluation, brave contestants!
欢迎各位成功进入第二轮评审的候选人们！

… A disembodied but sonorous and excited voice broke the silence through the speakers.
从不知安在何处的扬声器中突然传出了响亮的声音。

As there were numerous complaints regarding the possible partiality issues with our previous host, please understand that I will be taking over as the host with the start of the second round...
在积极听取了各式各样与公平性相关的意见后，最终决定由我担任第二轮评审的新主持人，还请各位理解……

… Looks like this Jia Zheng got kicked off from the host seat.
……看样子贾政被赶下主持人之位了。

Oi, hold on a minute. Up there, are they...
喂，等会……上头的那些……

Hah… Don’t tell me we’ve got a live audience.
哈……难道是观众吗？

What initially appeared to be a dilapidated rooftop was revealed to be where the spectator seats were installed. They were filled to the brim, to the point where I couldn't spot a single empty seat.
一无所剩的建筑顶端有一个乌泱泱坐满了人的观众席。

It would be reasonable to assume that they are indeed spectators, considering the way the seats are arranged.
从连椅子都配置好了这点来看，他们应该确实是观众。

There were some unfortunate troubles in the first round, yes, but hey. This is our once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to watch the Family Hierarch Evaluation live and in person! Is it worth it or what?
虽然第一轮评审中出现了一点小小的骚动，但我们下次旁观家主评审又要等到何时呢？

We wanted to give as many people as possible the opportunity to witness this history in the making.
如此罕见的活动，观众自然是越多越好。

Alrighty then! Before we really get the game rolling, please give the contestants a round of applause and cheer! Let them meet this challenge as their best selves!
来！在正式开始之前，请大家为全力备战的候选人们致以热烈的掌声！

dataList.title:
Daguanyuan
大观园
dataList.content:
YEAAAHHHH!!
好诶！！

Holy mackerel, what a shitshow.
啥呀，乱七八糟的。

They're sittin' on their arses, poppin' popcorn into their mouths while we're stuck shittin' bricks down here?
这是打算让上面那些家伙吃着点心，欣赏我们在下面拼死拼活的样子吗？

I'm sure they've been placing bets all night.
应该还会打赌吧。

Though I doubt many of them bet on us~
虽然估计几乎不会有赌我们赢的人吧~

They'll regret that.
他们会后悔的。

By the way... we're still indoors, right? Didn't we descend deep into a basement, even if we did ride a lift upward? How come there's a blue sky above us...?
不过……这里应该是室内吧？我记得我们是下降到了地下，可这蓝天……像是突然到了外面一样……

Hong Lu explained that we're still within the subterranean area of Hongyuan, but...
虽然鸿璐已经说过……这里还是鸿园的地下。

... most of the Sinners were having a hard time believing that with the pale blue sky above them.
但在电梯门打开后映入眼帘的湛蓝天空，还是令大多罪人感到难以置信。

Though this is a practice limited to the affluent class of Hongyuan, many have taken to installing artificial environments within their rooms. In fact, there are several buildings within Daguanyuan decorated in much the same manner. 
在鸿园内，唯有富人阶层可以根据喜好，人为地布置房间。而在大观园中，也已经存在几座根据房间主人兴趣装饰的建筑。

Yes, the road taken to visit the elders is similarly decorated. Always so sunny and green.
没错，去面见长辈们的路上也是这样装饰的。整条道路总是晴空万里，绿意盎然哦。

And it feels more like the outside than the actual outside.
可以说是比外界更像是外界吧。

So what's uh... that?
顺带一问……那是什么？

I realized that what Rodya was looking at was a parasol. It was installed in such a random place that I doubted it was actually there for anyone to sit under.
顺着罗佳的视线望去，那里突兀地留着一张像是谁曾在下方休息过一般的老旧遮阳伞。

Oh, that's a parasol.
啊，那是遮阳伞。

I-I know what a parasol is, alright...? I'm asking what that old thing is doing there all on its own?
遮……遮阳伞我当然认得……我问的是为什么那个废品似的遮阳伞还留在那边……

Mm…
嗯……

Hong Lu tilted his head, thinking.
鸿璐歪起头思考了片刻。

A real big shot who brought the Claws watched the whole thing from that seat.
带来爪牙的那位大人物曾在那里见证了一切。

The four houses left the parasol there because...
所以，四大家族特地保留了那柄遮阳伞的原因是……

... they wanted it to be a lasting reminder. A warning for the remaining houses, too.
希望能够长久铭记。也是为了展示给所有家族作为警告。

Reminder? ... Reminder for what?
铭记？……要铭记什么？

That we mustn't seek what is not permitted to us.
不应渴望未被应允之事。

That we should know our place, live the life we deserve, and part from this world the way we deserve.
人当应天而生，顺天而逝。

... Said the elders.
……长辈们是这么说的。

Shall we enter, now?
是时候进去了吧？

While we all gaped about like fish out of water in this unfamiliar environment,
正当大家迷惑不解时……

Hong Lu casually walked ahead of us into the building like he was out on a mundane stroll.
只有鸿璐驾轻就熟地向建筑内走去。

<I know you said you heard it all from the family elders, but...>
<虽然说是从长辈们那里听来的……>

<... you saw everything that happened here, didn't you? All of it.>
<但你实际上看到了吧……？那一切。>

Hong Lu paused, then turned around.
走在前方的鸿璐转身面向我们。

Yes, I probably did.
是啊，也许吧。

I'm starting to have less and less idea as to what his smile really means.
即使是我，现在也渐渐读不懂鸿璐脸上那副笑容的含义了。
